query: I transitioned to reading books and articles instead of listening to educational podcasts. It became apparent that the sheer volume of information presented in those podcasts was becoming overwhelming, almost to the point of creating a blockade in my learning process. The rapid pace of the discussions made it difficult for me to take notes or even digest the material fully, as my mind raced to keep up with the speakers. Consequently, I felt more confused than informed, leading me to seek out alternative formats for absorbing knowledge.
